name: Smear
description: The arc a whirled feeler leaves behind its tip — Cowboy's sweep (ss.char.arin `cast_evo`). The leading edge is at 0° and the tail trails back anticlockwise, so the engine turns the whole thing to wherever the tip is and draws it again a few degrees behind, fainter, for the afterimages. Three bands, thick to thin, white to frost, each on a band of ink a little wider: cold and cut-paper, never lit, since the player's marks do not glow. Authored at r 56 and drawn as geometry at the radius the turn really has (drawAsset), because that radius grows with the weapon's area and a bake scaled to it would blur.
